provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Ankh: Gods of Egypt rulebook (CMON, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Each player picks a god: God figure, 6 Warriors, God and Merged God dashboards, Ankh tokens, 7 Battle cards, Player Aid
Ra takes 3 Sun tokens, Osiris 3 Underworld tokens, Amun the Amun token
Each player starts with {n} Follower; the rest in a general supply (unlimited)
6 Ankh tokens on the bottom row of your god dashboard; the rest as your personal pool
Random first player (or whoever owns the most cats); clockwise order
In reverse order, stack plastic Ankh tokens on the bottom of the Devotion track (first player on top)
4 Action markers on the starting spaces for {n} players
Event marker on the first space of the Events track
Choose a scenario that allows your player count
Monuments, Conflict Order tokens and Camels as the scenario shows; rest (and the Battle Tiebreaker) in the supply
Figures and Ankh tokens per the scenario; the first player is player #1, then clockwise
Choose one Level 1, one Level 2 and one Level 3 Guardian card
Apply the scenario's Additional Setup Rules
Conflict Order tokens belong to whole regions, not single spaces
The first player takes an action
